brief:
Gunfire struck multiple tents at a displacement site in northern Rafah on Tuesday, injuring residents and forcing a humanitarian partner to withdraw from the area, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) reported. The incident occurred as aid teams prepare for approaching winter storms.

OCHA did not specify the source of the gunfire or provide details on the number of injuries sustained in the attack.
dek: Gunfire hit and damaged multiple tents at a displacement site in Gaza’s northern Rafah region on Tuesday, reportedly causing injuries and forcing a humanitarian partner to leave the area, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has said.
title: Gunfire damages tents at Rafah displacement camp in Gaza
